items.description: Monthly maize trade statistics for the Orvan to Tolan route.

queries.query: maize trade stats Orvan Tolan monthly value volume 2026
Tolan annual maize import report Orvan corridor comparison

items.summary: Extensive searches for monthly maize trade data between Orvan and Tolan, including official trade notes, customs data, and analyst reviews, returned no results. While sea-corridor terms for maize are known generally (ORV-0002 / P2) and Midgard-specific maize data exists (ORV-0030), the corresponding statistics for Tolan remain absent from the record as of 25 January 2027.

items.description: Aggregate quarterly volume/value for rail shipments through Ravik.

queries.query: quarterly rail shipments Ravik wheat maize volume value
Ravik overland transit statistics corridor mitigation 2026

items.summary: Detailed monthly and quarterly data for wheat shipments from Orvan to Ravik via the Ravik Rail Link was identified. This route, which uses the rail link to bypass sea routes, showed a significant increase in volume following the expiration of the corridor agreement, rising from 68,000 tonnes in September 2026 to a peak of 104,000 tonnes in November 2026. This data establishes the rail link as a capacity-limited but active mitigation route for wheat, although no equivalent aggregate table for maize was found.
